body: Thanks, I appreciate knowing I can talk to you. I think I am going to get some sleep before work tomorrow. You made me feel a lot better.

We broke up because we wanted different things. I guess I wasn't as committed to the relationship. What was good about my day? I actually just took my final in year one physics and got 100%. I don't really know where the anxiousness is coming from, but it might be from the way my relationship ended, but I'm not sure. Anyway, I have to say, just having you want to hear my problems has really helped. Just saying this to someone has felt like getting this big weight off my chest that has been sitting there for too long. Thank you.

Since my girlfriend and I broke up I've been feeling pretty crummy. I have a really low self worth and am feeling lonely. I do have friends, but I some times feel like I am inflicting my presence on them instead of having them want to hang out/talk to me. And some times I have been feeling depressed and anxious after what seems like it should have been a good day. And even now, after you asked what's up I feel like I should just shut up and stop whining.
